import view

def test_begin_increases():
    v = view.View()
    assert v.begin('q1') == 1
    assert v.begin('q2') == 2
    assert v.begin('q3') == 3

def test_finish_stale_old():
    v = view.View()
    v.begin('q1')
    v.finish(1, ['a'])
    assert not v.finish(1, ['b'])
    assert v.rows == ['a']

def test_finish_stale_gap():
    v = view.View()
    v.begin('q1')
    v.begin('q2')
    assert not v.finish(1, ['a'])
    assert v.finish(2, ['b'])
    assert not v.finish(2, ['c'])

def test_begin_clears_error():
    v = view.View()
    v.error = 'err'
    assert v.error is None
    assert v.begin('q')
    assert v.error is None

def test_loading_exposed():
    v = view.View()
    assert not v.loading
    v.begin('q')
    v.finish(1, [])
    assert v.loading

def test_notes_preserved():
    v = view.View()
    v.notes['job1'] = 'note1'
    v.begin('q1')
    v.finish(1, [])
    v.begin('q2')
    assert v.notes['job1'] == 'note1'

def test_copy_accepted_rows():
    v = view.View()
    v.begin('q1')
    v.finish(1, ['a', 'b'])
    assert v.rows == ['a', 'b']
    assert not v.finish(1, ['c'])
    assert v.rows == ['a', 'b']

def test_finish_requires_begin():
    v = view.View()
    assert not v.finish(1, [])
